audit.backfilledHint: This entry predates typed targets. Its label be th' target's name today rather than its name at th' time, an' a target that has since been deleted has no label at all.
audit.description: Every privileged action, newest first. Expand an entry fer its target id an' what changed.
audit.noDiff: No field-level changes recorded fer this action.

enrichment.description: Re-fetch artwork, artist images, bios, release dates an' genres fer everythin' in yer hoards. Useful after addin' Last.fm / fanart.tv API keys. Runs in th' background an' be rate-limited, so a large hoard fills in gradually.
enrichment.refetching: {count, plural, one {Re-fetchin' # item in th' background…} other {Re-fetchin' # items in th' background…}}

explorer.description: Browse th' Hub's own tables. Nothin' here can be edited.

metadata.artistSubtitle: {albumCount, plural, one {# treasure} other {# treasures}} · {trackCount, plural, one {# ditty} other {# ditties}}
metadata.currentArtistHint: Currently {name}. Hunt t' re-attribute t' a different artist.
metadata.intro: Edit th' divvied catalog that all hands sees: rename an artist, treasure or ditty, replace its artwork, or re-attribute a release t' a different artist. These changes be global an' permanent (unlike per-hoard edits). Every change be recorded in th' audit log.
metadata.noAlbumCovers: No covers spied. Cover Art Archive may not have any fer this release.
metadata.noArtistArtwork: No artwork spied. fanart.tv may not have any fer this artist, or this Hub has no fanart.tv key.
metadata.noLogos: No logos spied. fanart.tv may not have any fer this label, or this Hub has no fanart.tv key.
metadata.searchHint: Keep typin': {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} at least.

noAccess.body: Ye don't have access t' site administration. {link}.

suggestions.titleWithCount: {count, plural, one {Metadata suggestions (# pendin')} other {Metadata suggestions (# pendin')}}

system.rollupLagHelp: How far th' background aggregator be behind th' newest listen. Zero means it has caught up wi' everythin' recorded.

backups.description: Archives written by th' nightly backup, an' th' erasure ledger that stops a restore bringin' deleted accounts back.
backups.lookingIn: Archives on this server, in {directory}. Copies in object storage be separate an' be not listed here, so deletin' one thar leaves this list unchanged.
backups.unconfigured: No backups directory be configured, so thar be nothin' t' list. Set CHORDIA_BACKUPS_DIR an' mount it read-only.
backups.none: No archives on this server yet. Th' nightly backup writes one at 2:27 AM an' keeps 30 days o' 'em here.
backups.remoteOnlyHint: Not on this server, so it can't be checked or restored from here. Plunder it from object storage into th' backups directory first.
backups.localOnlyHint: Not in object storage. It won't survive losin' this machine.
backups.sizeMismatch: Th' two copies be different sizes ({local} here, {remote} off-site). One o' 'em be incomplete.
backups.remoteUnreachable: Couldn't read object storage, so only this server's copies be listed. {problem}
backups.plaintextHint: This archive holds every watchword hash an' TOTP secret on th' instance in th' clear. Set AGE_RECIPIENT in backup.sh.
backups.ledgerOff: Erasure ledger be NOT mirrored. Restorin' will bring back every account deleted since th' archive were taken.
backups.keyHint: Used fer this request only. It be ne'er stored, logged, or written t' disk.
backups.truncated: Archive be incomplete an' cannot be restored
backups.replayNote: They be erased again automatically after th' restore. Th' number be shown so it be a decision rather than a surprise.
backups.confirmBody: This replaces th' entire database wi' th' contents o' this archive. Everythin' since it were taken be lost. A safety copy be written first.
backups.confirmPrompt: Type th' archive name t' confirm
backups.restored: Restored. {count, plural, one {# account were erased again} other {# accounts were erased again}}.

userDetail.activeDays: {count, plural, one {# day wi' listenin''} other {# days wi' listenin''}}
userDetail.noHistory: Nothin' has been done t' this account.

users.deleteConfirm: Permanently scuttle @{handle} an' ALL their data? This cannot be undone.
users.suspendConfirm: Suspend @{handle}? They'll be signed out an' unable t' log in.
